tolerance_rule: approximate published values may reconcile within 25 EUR_million
materiality_rule: material if official account differs by more than 25 EUR_million
resolution: Prefer final audited Social Security account for institutional cash expenditure while preserving EC value as approximate benchmark
notes: EC reports about EUR 0.5bn; Tribunal de Contas reports EUR 516.0m for the same banking substitute-regime expenditure.

tolerance_rule: ESA treatment conflicts are resolved by estimand not by preference
materiality_rule: material if classification changes deficit effect by at least 0.1 percent GDP
resolution: Preserve ESA-95 deficit-improving treatment and ESA-2010 financial-transaction treatment as separate estimands
notes: Same transaction has a direct ESA-95 deficit effect and no direct ESA-2010 deficit effect.

tolerance_rule: rounded account tables may reconcile within 0.05 EUR_million
materiality_rule: material if rounded account differs from legal value by more than 0.05 EUR_million
resolution: Legal exact amount and rounded account table reconcile within tolerance
notes: DL88 exact value reconciles to the rounded Tribunal de Contas BPN reserve constitution value.

tolerance_rule: rounded totals may reconcile within 0.1 EUR_million
materiality_rule: material if component sum differs from rounded total by more than 0.1 EUR_million
resolution: Round EUR 515.8m State Budget plus EUR 0.1359m CGA component to the EUR 516.0m total
notes: Same official audit reports both rounded total and component split.

tolerance_rule: no reconciliation tolerance because values are not the same accounting quantity
materiality_rule: material because values differ by more than 100 EUR_million
resolution: Do not net or choose one value; preserve total transfer value and booked non-tax-revenue receipt as separate accounting items
notes: CGE reports aggregate bank pension-fund transfer value and a separate 2011 booked asset-title receipt; final bank-level asset composition remains unresolved.
